cond_0001.intro: The Research Scientist III will both lead and participate in basic and applied research in the fields of Wildlife Ecology and Global Change Biology. They will design and carry out research examining how small mammal species affect terrestrial biogeochemical cycling using a combination of remote sensing, camera traps, and replicated field experiments. They will lead the collection, processing, analysis, and interpretation of data, and will author and co-author peer-reviewed publications describing research findings. The Research Scientist will both lead and contribute to externally funded proposals to maintain their position.
cond_0228.requirements: Around two years of postdoctoral research experience, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant research training. A background in species range limits theory is expected, though candidates still developing depth in this area are welcome to apply. Experience with developing methods for monitoring wildlife and climate — candidates with working knowledge of cost-effective field approaches are encouraged. A background in estimating demographic parameters and modeling species-environmental relationships at local and regional scales; familiarity with these methods, even if still being refined, is valued. We consider candidates holistically and recognize that relevant skills can be strengthened on the job.

cond_0648.responsibilities: The Research Scientist III will coordinate with and contribute to both basic and applied research in Wildlife Ecology and Global Change Biology. The Scientist will work alongside a group of researchers examining interactions and feedbacks among wildlife, climate change, and biogeochemical cycling. Together, the team will design and carry out research examining how small mammal species affect terrestrial biogeochemical cycling using a combination of remote sensing, camera traps, and replicated field experiments. The Scientist will collaborate on the collection, processing, analysis, and interpretation of data, and will co-author and author peer-reviewed publications describing research findings. The Research Scientist will also work with colleagues to contribute to and help lead externally funded proposals to maintain their position.
